game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the program_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about program_ok to power up the caravan guide and open the sundial.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Program Assembler
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how program_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
